g.text: Prototype accounts use Argon2 password hashes.
Role/profile consistency is enforced by account creation logic.
Unique(studentUserId, opportunityId): one application per student and opportunity.
Declined requires decisionReason; final decisions set decisionAt.
Only published, not-yet-expired opportunities accept applications.
Published opportunities require a deadline and at least one research area.
Resume and photo files live in private object storage;
only opaque storage keys are stored in the database.
Proposed constraint: exactly two users, one student and one professor.
Every message sender must be a participant in its conversation.
